integrity: Single specific theorem with analytic proof and standalone finite checker; no independent mathematical audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite planar complete centrally symmetric fans containing all four coordinate rays; exponent 0<p<1. No claims for rotated, arbitrary or higher-dimensional fans; numerical checks supplement analytic proof. General quasi-norm theory, classical lp modulus and spline interpolation are credited to prior work.
title: Sharp angular-knot law for quasi-triangle moduli of sampled planar \(\ell_p\) conic splines
